## Quality Checklist
Before requesting review, please confirm you have met the repository quality standards:

- [ ] **Originality**: Questions and explanations are original and not plagiarized from proprietary courses or copyrighted books.
- [ ] **No Duplicates**: Verified that questions do not duplicate existing questions in the repository.
- [ ] **10-Point Standard Format**: Questions strictly follow the 10-point standard format (One-Line Answer, Detailed Answer, Practical Example, Internal Working, Real-World Use Case, Follow-Up Questions, Common Mistakes, Tip, Related Concepts, References).
- [ ] **Accurate Difficulty**: Assigned difficulty (Basic / Intermediate / Advanced) matches the criteria in `docs/difficulty-levels.md`.
- [ ] **Tested Code**: All Python, SQL, Dockerfile, or Bash code snippets are tested and runnable.
- [ ] **Valid References**: Links point to official documentation (e.g., docs.python.org, fastapi.tiangolo.com).
- [ ] **Validation Script**: Ran `py scripts/validate_repository.py` locally and all checks passed without errors.
- [ ] **Markdown Formatted**: Clean markdown syntax, valid headings, no broken table of contents.
